description: ENAPOA crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C88 H96 Dy4 N17 O27 3+,2(C1 H4 O1),3(N1 O3 1-),H2 O1. From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.826-3.826 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 95.59-110.33°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Dy4L4(NO3)](NO3)2·2CH3OH·H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
